title: Require Resource Proof Topology
forbids: resource proof outside the provider-neutral contract axis
why: A resource owns only the neutral capability contract. Closing its proof tree around compile-time consumer and provider assignability prevents provider execution, product policy, or service behavior from collecting beside that contract.
remediate: Keep provider-neutral assignability proof under test/contract. Move concrete acquisition and collaboration proof to the provider, and move semantic product outcomes to the consuming service.
message: Resource proof must remain closed around its provider-neutral contract.
